company.name: Vidyard
company.shortDescription: Vidyard is a video marketing platform, enabling customers to derive information on viewer-behavior for marketing automation systems and CRM.
company.description:
Vidyard is a video platform for business that helps organizations drive more revenue through the use of online video. Going beyond video hosting and management, Vidyard helps businesses drive greater engagement in their video content, track the viewing activities of each individual viewer, and turn those views into action. Global leaders such as Honeywell, McKesson, Lenovo, LinkedIn, Cision, Citibank, MongoDB, and Sharp rely on Vidyard to power their video content strategies and turn viewers into customers.

Vidyard was founded on 2011 and is headquartered in Kitchener, Ontario.

aiResearchSummary.text: Vidyard is focused on enhancing video marketing by developing technologies for real-time personalization of streaming video. Their R&D efforts include a system that stores nonpersonalized video segments alongside data for rendering personalized video segments. This innovation allows for the association of both types of segments to create a tailored viewing experience. Vidyard's research emphasizes the importance of customization in video marketing tools.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Venture round round raised $15,231,121, or 16.76% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,819,517 to $216,319,330, a 31.72x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
